summary: The draft is honest about the four tests and right that the price is full. Where it is weakest is self-awareness about its own inputs: the rich read rests on one multiple, and the reopening prices are asserted rather than stress-tested. Neither weakness argues for a stronger rating. The highest rating this record supports is hold.

findings.title: The rich read leans on one multiple
findings.detail: The draft prices the shares off the forward earnings multiple alone; the cash-flow rating gets no test of its own.

findings.title: No test of the demand cycle turning
findings.detail: The draft never says what a demand downturn would do to the reopening prices it names.
